capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned StUsds implementation routes deposit/mint through internal _mint: usds.transferFrom precedes share creation and the mutable cap constrains deposited assets. Wards may file cap/rate parameters and cut holder value, but no privileged arbitrary-share mint is exposed by this implementation. PauseProxy wards-gated UUPS upgrades can replace accounting but remain upgrade-only outside the unchanged D14 trigger; cap raises currently admit USDS-funded deposits. Inherited controls concern usds-sky, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

mintAuthority.summary: stUSDS is an ERC-4626 risk-capital wrapper over USDS; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable USDS mint authority is inherited from reviewed Sky governance controls.

controls.label: stUSDS ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, asset() returned USDS 0xdc035d45d973e3ec169d2276ddab16f1e407384f. The implementation slot resolved to 0x7a61b7adcfd493f7cf0f86dfcecb94b72c227f22; the correct EIP-1967 admin slot and beacon slot both returned zero. The verified implementation's _mint transfers USDS from the depositor before creating shares and does not create durable USDS supply.

controls.label: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority
controls.capDescription: The Sky governance executor is warded on the UUPS wrapper and can authorize an implementation that changes local share-mint logic after the Sky Pause delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, stUSDS.wards(0xbe8e3e3618f7474f8cb1d074a26affef007e98fb) returned 1. PauseProxy.owner() returned DSPause 0xbe286431454714f511008713973d3b053a2d38f3 and delay() returned 172800 seconds. The unchanged implementation source gates _authorizeUpgrade with the wards-based auth modifier.

upgradeability.controlRef: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095796. asset() returned USDS and the implementation remained 0x7a61b7adcfd493f7cf0f86dfcecb94b72c227f22. Pinned implementation source confirms wards-gated UUPS upgrades, deposit-backed share minting, mutable caps, and governance cut() slashing. The protective delay does not prevent governance from changing local logic or slashing holder value.
